recipe.visualDefinition: A central, large red heart sits atop a layered, multi-textured background featuring watercolor washes, ink splatters, and faint geometric blocks in warm tones of orange, yellow, and cream. The composition uses a mix of organic fluid shapes and rigid rectangular overlays to create a sense of depth and controlled chaos.
coreVisualRelationships: Central heart as the primary focal point against a busy background
Contrast between organic watercolor bleeds and sharp geometric edges
Warm color harmony unifying disparate texture layers
Small iconographic elements balanced against large central forms
coreInvariants: Warm-toned color palette (red, orange, yellow, cream)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large heart dominates the center of the frame, occupying approximately 50% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central heart acts as the primary anchor, supported by a secondary teardrop shape in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central heart, moves upward to the top display text, then spirals outward to the corners where smaller icons and textures reside.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the background is densely packed with textures and washes, though the cream-colored areas provide brief visual relief.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and yellows provide the atmospheric background wash.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep saturated red defines the central heart and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream and off-white act as highlights and base layers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central elements with lower-value, desaturated washes in the background layers.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool colors like blue or green

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a heavy, tight-tracked geometric sans-serif
Secondary text uses a high-contrast, bracketed serif with wide tracking
All caps for all primary and secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the display text are tightly kerned to the point of touching or overlapping slightly

composition.relationshipToImage: knocked out or overlaid on the heart

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, modern sans-serif for the brand/artist name paired with a delicate, traditional serif for the title/message.

preserve: Tight tracking of the top text
Wide tracking of the center text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, heavy feel of the top display text.
Provides the high-contrast serif look for the central text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mixed-media background with layers of orange, yellow, and cream watercolor washes. Add a large, textured red heart in the center and a smaller red teardrop in the bottom right. Include subtle ink splatters and semi-transparent rectangular overlays to create depth.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, tight-tracked geometric sans-serif title in red at the top. Inside the heart, add two lines of wide-tracked serif text in a light cream color, centered vertically and horizontally.

verificationChecks: Is the heart the central focus?
Are the watercolor textures visible and layered?
Is the top text bold and tightly spaced?
Is the center text serif and widely spaced?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure textures don't obscure the legibility of the text.
Check that the red of the heart and the red of the top text are harmonious.
Verify the 'collage' feel through visible layer edges.
Confirm the teardrop icon is present in the lower right quadrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Layered watercolor textures + central symbolic silhouette + high-contrast typographic pairing (Bold Sans / Wide Serif).
